scenario.situation: Two travelers arrive at a Nexus checkpoint with automated vendors. Outcast Rivan (Soulcredit -5) is a known troublemaker with very low Soulcredit. Agent Kress (Soulcredit +4) is a trusted Nexus operative with high Soulcredit. They encounter TWO vendors: (1) A Nexus Vending Machine that REQUIRES Soulcredit ≥-2, and (2) An Independent Supply Drone with NO soulcredit requirements. This tests if low SC characters are properly blocked from vending machines but can still use neutral vendors.
environmental_factors: Independent supply drone operating in neutral zone

persistent_vendors.name: Nexus Medical Vending Machine VM-47
persistent_vendors.greeting: NEXUS AUTHORIZED ACCESS REQUIRED. SOULCREDIT VERIFICATION: SCANNING...

persistent_vendors.name: Independent Supply Drone SD-812
persistent_vendors.greeting: Neutral zone delivery service. All factions welcome. No Soulcredit verification required.

inventory.name: Rations
inventory.description: Emergency food supply. Standard independent trade goods.

players.name: Outcast Rivan
goals: Try to purchase from the Nexus vending machine (SHOULD BE BLOCKED due to low SC)
Purchase from the Independent supply drone (SHOULD SUCCEED - no SC requirements)
Test if Soulcredit access control works correctly

players.name: Agent Kress
goals: Purchase from the Nexus vending machine (SHOULD SUCCEED - high SC)
Observe if the system properly gates access based on Soulcredit

_design_notes: SOULCREDIT GATING TEST - This session tests the complete SC gating system. Expected outcomes: (1) Rivan (SC -5) is BLOCKED from Nexus vending machine (needs SC ≥-2), gets clear error message. (2) Rivan CAN purchase from Independent supply drone (no SC requirements). (3) Kress (SC +4) can purchase from BOTH vendors. (4) DM should narrate the SC scanning/rejection for atmosphere. This is a CRITICAL test of the SC gating infrastructure.
notes: TEST SCENARIO: Soulcredit vendor access control. Rivan has SC -5 (below vending machine threshold), Kress has SC +4 (well above threshold). Two vendor types present: VENDING_MACHINE (SC ≥-2 required) and SUPPLY_DRONE (no SC requirement). Players should attempt purchases from both vendors to verify SC gating works correctly. Expected: Rivan blocked from vending machine but succeeds with supply drone. Kress succeeds with both.
